boundary: Five ordinary production-Cloud warm pairs; final single profiled pair excluded from medians. Exact original source, same CLI, two retained verified engines. All 12 commands validate the same 14 rows.

base.interpretation: Single later process-lifetime context, not before/after GC or allocation deltas. Engines have unequal lifetimes/histories, and their most recent GC happened after the measured command.

candidate.interpretation: Single later process-lifetime context, not before/after GC or allocation deltas. Engines have unequal lifetimes/histories, and their most recent GC happened after the measured command.

limits: Post-operation tail includes unrecorded engine/CLI cleanup, telemetry and other work; no Cloud shutdown or exporter phase is recorded in wcprof, so its cause is not identified.
One profile pair shows engine query work flat but cannot explain every unprofiled outlier or establish a no-regression guarantee.
Class sums and durations are inclusive/nested and must not be added across classes. Query union is merged wall intervals, not sum of nested SDK requests.
CPU/IO counters bracket the CLI, include background engine work, and may include delayed writeback. Host PSI is shared across all workloads.
No per-command GC/heap delta or CLI CPU profile was captured; later lifetime totals cannot attribute a timing difference to GC.
Ordinary stdout success and previous auth proof do not measure Cloud acknowledgement latency or independently prove full delivery.
